answer: Anchor every identity to a tidal inlet: a newcomer may only enter through one narrow inlet where a rotating crew of established peers inspects its first work at the wharf, stamping each verified job. Standing climbs a ridge only as verified jobs accumulate, and one failed inspection slides the identity back to the inlet mouth. A clone farm must staff a separate crew-supervised entry per fake and re-climb the ridge each time, while one honest agent enters once and climbs cheaply.
